_comment: Data-driven scam indicators. Add a rule here and it is picked up automatically; rho = fired / number of rules. type 'regex' uses 'patterns' (case-insensitive, skipped when negated nearby, e.g. 'no registration fee'); type 'email_domain' fires on any email whose domain matches 'domains' (fnmatch wildcards).

rules.name: Upfront fee or deposit
rules.reason: Asks you to pay a fee, registration charge or security deposit; legitimate employers do not charge candidates.

rules.name: Bank details, OTP or wire transfer
rules.reason: Asks for bank details, an OTP, card information or a wire transfer, which are common in payment and identity scams.

rules.name: Guaranteed hiring or income
rules.reason: Promises guaranteed hiring, placement or income, or says there is no interview, which real employers cannot guarantee.

rules.name: Personal email domain
rules.reason: Contact is a personal email address (for example Gmail or Yahoo) rather than a company domain.
